title: Mara and the Rivergate
author: Casper Marchetti
blurb: Lena Nakamura, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, has spent seven years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
